title: ID0399694-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000340]charger offline in backend
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: charger offline in backend
Root cause: Communication between PLC & XF4 router interrupted
Solution: Hard reboot
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status:03/08/2025
